changes.title: Bounded clipboard memory
changes.detail: History indexes retain metadata and process-local keyed fingerprints instead of the entire plaintext history. On-demand payload cache has fixed 30-second, 16-entry and character limits and clears at editor/panel privacy boundaries.

changes.title: Private recognition practice
changes.detail: Tap the sampled recognition map to see original and adapted decisions without training or retaining the sample.

changes.title: Swipe correction inspection
changes.detail: Inspect all existing bounded encrypted correction pairs and forget individual pairs.
